rules.condition: formal inputs require variable-level provenance or explicit limitations
institutional assumptions must be versioned, approved, active, immutable and resolved through the repository library
assumption dependencies must exist and remain acyclic
critical epistemic or mixed assumptions require falsification and invalidation conditions
critical excluded or unknown mechanisms prevent high-stakes credibility approval
stochastic formal use requires registered design, fixed seeds, adequate replications and a stopping rule
high-stakes use requires every risk-adjusted credibility factor to meet its threshold with evidence
all hard constraints pass before execution and after solver completion
operation and mode resolve to a non-retired registered model
non-identifiable parameters cannot be interpreted as unique mechanisms
formal complex models require sample-out evidence and a simple baseline
failed identification, overlap, pretrend, weak-IV or refutation checks downgrade output to association
formal propagation analysis requires multiple seeds or explicit deterministic justification
supplied or learned dependency structures are not automatically causal
high-stakes release requires explicit user approval, benchmark evidence and independent cross-check
severe calibration failure or drift requires recalibration before reuse
expired or retired models cannot be used for new formal decisions
